(async()=>{const CK=(await import('/js/flight/cockpit.js')).CK, THREE=await import('three'); const ray=new THREE.Raycaster(), meshes=[]; CK.model.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.visible&&!(CK.glass||[]).includes(o)) meshes.push(o)}); CK.group.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv=CK.group.matrixWorld.clone().invert(); const cast=(o,d)=>{ray.set(CK.group.localToWorld(o.clone()), d.clone().transformDirection(CK.group.matrixWorld)); ray.far=2; const h=ray.intersectObjects(meshes,false)[0]; if(!h) return null; const p=h.point.clone().applyMatrix4(inv); const n=h.face.normal.clone().transformDirection(h.object.matrixWorld).transformDirection(inv); return [+p.y.toFixed(2), +n.x.toFixed(1), +n.y.toFixed(1), +n.z.toFixed(1)]}; const down={}, up={}; for (let x=-0.9;x<=0.01;x+=0.1) for (let z=0.0;z<=0.91;z+=0.1){ down[x.toFixed(1)+','+z.toFixed(1)]=cast(new THREE.Vector3(x,0.05,z), new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0)); up[x.toFixed(1)+','+z.toFixed(1)]=cast(new THREE.Vector3(x,0.1,z), new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)); } return JSON.stringify({down, up})})()
